_how: One note per user-visible change, written at release time in plain words (what users now see or can do). Every Friday 17:00 IST the job sends the notes dated after the last Friday's email (comms/whats_new/send_weekly.py). 'highlight': true = the box at the top.
coming_next: Numbers that match Power BI, checked every run (OSI-045, our top priority).
Track what happens after an alert: owner, status and follow-up (OSI-007, 046).
Shorter emails you can configure per project (OSI-043, 044).
Trend charts for the last weeks (OSI-010, 038).
Error types behind rejections, once the ORBIT QC feedback categories are available (OSI-027).

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Root causes and actions in every email
notes.text: When one of your KPIs misses your alert level, the email now explains why and what to do: for FTA, whether a few editors or one work package cause the rejections; for CoQ, whether it comes from more rejections, more sampling, slower QC or a change in the work; for efficiency, the work packages losing the most hours; for yield, the work unit behind it. Every number comes from the data, so it can be checked.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Exact dates everywhere
notes.text: every email and subject shows the Mon–Sun dates it covers: "this week so far", or "last week" on Mondays, with the previous full week as reference and a note when the sample is still small.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Alerts wait for enough data
notes.text: early in the week alerts use last week until this week has enough QC'd tasks and hours, so a Monday morning no longer shows extreme values.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Six headline KPIs, your alert levels
notes.text: FTA, efficiency vs baseline, CoQ, yield, hours and sampling are always shown; only the KPIs you set an alert level for are coloured and alerted.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Alerts for the process types and planning IDs you chose
notes.text: alert levels set for part of your scope are checked on that part only.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Work units
notes.text: every email splits the figures by work unit, and the operator list for leads is grouped by work unit with how many operators are past a level in each.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Operators past your alert levels (leads)
notes.text: only the operators past one of your own levels, with all six KPIs, those with the most hours first.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Yield for every profile
notes.text: shown for all Orbit SD scopes, also per planning ID, with alerts; a note explains when your work has no yield data yet.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Efficiency explained
notes.text: actual vs baseline tasks per hour next to the percentage.

notes.area: Daily Briefing, Weekly Report and Alerts
notes.title: Clear status line
notes.text: the top of the email now names the reason (for example "3 Jira tickets past the SLA" or "CoQ 14.6% past your alert level"), and a KPI without an alert level never turns the email red.

notes.title: Only recent tickets
notes.text: by default tickets created in the last 12 months; your profile can set its own window.

notes.title: Your own SLA levels
notes.text: in hours or days, as set in your profile; the email explains the rule.

notes.title: All open tickets counted
notes.text: up to 1,000 per profile; the email lists the oldest 100.

notes.title: Status Report: paste a list
notes.text: paste process types or planning IDs to set the scope in one step.

notes.title: Status Report keeps working when the AI model is busy
notes.text: it switches to the backup model automatically.

notes.title: Chat answers with the right history
notes.text: the chat now knows its data covers about the last 90 days.

notes.title: Self Service: QC Promotion (under development, admins)
notes.text: a new card to promote tasks to QC from a CSV or Excel file of task IDs; the file is checked as soon as it is chosen. Staging only while it is tested; the connection to ORBIT follows.
